meta.name: invoice
meta.description: 标准发票: 寄件/收件 + 明细 + 税 + 总额 + 付款指引

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成标准发票，包含明细、税额和付款指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成符合税务规范的发票
copy.tagline_en: Generate standard invoices with line items, tax, and payment instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate tax-compliant invoices

howto.what: Claude 会输出一张 A4 可打印发票单页:头部写发票号/日期/截止日,分出 From 与 Bill to 两块,明细表含描述/数量/单价/金额,下方是税项拆分与右对齐总额,还有付款指引区,并带打印样式。
howto.when: 当你需要一张标准发票、账单或可打印的收费单页时触发。

say.text: 帮我开一张发票:收件方 ABC 公司,3 项服务,加 6% 税
把这张发票的付款指引换成银行转账信息
发票号 INV-001,截止日 3 月 31 日,排成 A4 版
say.note: 按给定抬头与日期排版

howto.what_en: Claude outputs a printable A4 invoice: header with number/date/due date, From and Bill to blocks, a line-items table, tax breakdown, right-aligned totals and payment instructions, plus print styles.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a standard invoice, bill or printable charge page.

say_en.text: Make an invoice for ABC Inc., 3 service items, plus 6% tax
Change the payment instructions on this invoice to bank transfer details
Use invoice number INV-001, due March 31, format as A4
say_en.note: Lays out with given header and dates
